mapper.select: SELECT TYPE_ID AS typeId, TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, TYPE_CODE AS typeCode, TYPE_NAME AS typeName, DEDUCTION_KIND AS deductionKind, RATE AS rate, LIMIT_AMOUNT AS limitAmount, SALARY_MIN AS salaryMin, SALARY_MAX AS salaryMax, CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, SOURCE_NOTE AS sourceNote, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, UPDATED_BY AS updatedBy FROM DEDUCTION_TYPE WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} ORDER BY TYPE_ID ASC

SELECT BRACKET_ID AS bracketId, TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, BRACKET_TYPE AS bracketType, LOWER_AMOUNT AS lowerAmount, UPPER_AMOUNT AS upperAmount, RATE AS rate, BASE_AMOUNT AS baseAmount, SOURCE_NOTE AS sourceNote, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, UPDATED_BY AS updatedBy FROM TAX_BRACKET WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} ORDER BY BRACKET_TYPE ASC, LOWER_AMOUNT ASC

SELECT BENEFIT_ID AS benefitId, TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, BENEFIT_CODE AS benefitCode, BENEFIT_NAME AS benefitName, MIN_AGE AS minAge, MAX_AGE AS maxAge, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS AS maxMilitaryMonths, COMPANY_SIZE AS companySize, SALARY_LIMIT AS salaryLimit, HOMELESS_HOUSEHOLD_YN AS homelessHouseholdYn, REDUCTION_RATE AS reductionRate, LIMIT_AMOUNT AS limitAmount, PERIOD_YEARS AS periodYears, SOURCE_NOTE AS sourceNote, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, UPDATED_BY AS updatedBy FROM BENEFIT_CONDITION WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} ORDER BY BENEFIT_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BENEFIT_CONDITION ( TAX_YEAR, BENEFIT_CODE, BENEFIT_NAME, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS, COMPANY_SIZE, SALARY_LIMIT, HOMELESS_HOUSEHOLD_YN, REDUCTION_RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_YEARS, SOURCE_NOTE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{dto.taxYear}, #{dto.code}, #{dto.name}, #{dto.minAge}, #{dto.maxAge}, #{dto.maxMilitaryMonths}, #{dto.companySize}, #{dto.salaryLimit}, #{dto.homelessHouseholdYn}, #{dto.rate}, #{dto.limitAmount}, #{dto.periodYears}, #{dto.sourceNote}, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE DEDUCTION_TYPE SET TYPE_NAME = #{dto.name}, DEDUCTION_KIND = #{dto.deductionKind}, RATE = #{dto.rate}, LIMIT_AMOUNT = #{dto.limitAmount}, SALARY_MIN = #{dto.salaryMin}, SALARY_MAX = #{dto.salaryMax}, CATEGORY_ID = #{dto.categoryId}, PAY_METHOD = #{dto.payMethod}, SOURCE_NOTE = #{dto.sourceNote}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE TYPE_ID = #{dto.id}

UPDATE TAX_BRACKET SET BRACKET_TYPE = #{dto.code}, LOWER_AMOUNT = #{dto.lowerAmount}, UPPER_AMOUNT = #{dto.upperAmount}, RATE = #{dto.rate}, BASE_AMOUNT = #{dto.baseAmount}, SOURCE_NOTE = #{dto.sourceNote}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE BRACKET_ID = #{dto.id}

UPDATE BENEFIT_CONDITION SET BENEFIT_NAME = #{dto.name}, MIN_AGE = #{dto.minAge}, MAX_AGE = #{dto.maxAge}, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS = #{dto.maxMilitaryMonths}, COMPANY_SIZE = #{dto.companySize}, SALARY_LIMIT = #{dto.salaryLimit}, HOMELESS_HOUSEHOLD_YN = #{dto.homelessHouseholdYn}, REDUCTION_RATE = #{dto.rate}, LIMIT_AMOUNT = #{dto.limitAmount}, PERIOD_YEARS = #{dto.periodYears}, SOURCE_NOTE = #{dto.sourceNote}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE BENEFIT_ID = #{dto.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEDUCTION_TYPE ( TAX_YEAR, TYPE_CODE, TYPE_NAME, DEDUCTION_KIND, RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, SALARY_MIN, SALARY_MAX, CATEGORY_ID, PAY_METHOD, SOURCE_NOTE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) SELECT #{targetYear}, TYPE_CODE, TYPE_NAME, DEDUCTION_KIND, RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, SALARY_MIN, SALARY_MAX, CATEGORY_ID, PAY_METHOD, SOURCE_NOTE, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy} FROM DEDUCTION_TYPE WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{sourceYear}

INSERT INTO BENEFIT_CONDITION ( TAX_YEAR, BENEFIT_CODE, BENEFIT_NAME, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS, COMPANY_SIZE, SALARY_LIMIT, HOMELESS_HOUSEHOLD_YN, REDUCTION_RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_YEARS, SOURCE_NOTE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) SELECT #{targetYear}, BENEFIT_CODE, BENEFIT_NAME, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS, COMPANY_SIZE, SALARY_LIMIT, HOMELESS_HOUSEHOLD_YN, REDUCTION_RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_YEARS, SOURCE_NOTE, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy} FROM BENEFIT_CONDITION WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{sourceYear}
